market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $130 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: CL at ~$103, recent peak $109. Hitting a $130 settlement by end of June requires a ~26% rise from spot — a major escalation of the Hormuz crisis. With ongoing tensions but also negotiation tracks active, this is a low-but-non-trivial tail. Probability ~18-25%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether a major military escalation in the Gulf occurs over the next two months.
